PeerComparisonData.description:
Structured metrics and fixture pointer for provider peer comparison.
Used by peer_comparison.py to compute percentile rank and median ratios deterministically.

region.description: Geographic region / peer market (e.g. US-Northeast, NY-Metro)
region.title: Region

cohort_size.description: Number of peers in the specialty/region cohort
cohort_size.title: Cohort Size

provider_metric_value.description: Provider's metric value (e.g. Mod 25 billing rate)
provider_metric_value.title: Provider Metric Value

peer_median.description: Median metric value across the peer cohort
peer_median.title: Peer Median

fixture_ref.description: Path or key to detailed peer distribution fixture
fixture_ref.title: Fixture Ref
